meta.source: Stages from rules/magic_rules.json (10/25/50/75/100). Visibility follows rules/classes/veil_sorceress.json corruption_system: never on the sheet; at 75 'friends begin to notice something is wrong'; at 90 'the Veil speaks with your voice'; 100 hollowed. Clearly visible only when the character is already 1-2 steps from lost.

stages.label: whispered
gm_notes: faint dark threads in the veins of the wrists, only seen by someone looking closely in good light
stages.player_hint: Sometimes you hear your name when no one speaks.

stages.label: marked
gm_notes: minor mutation begins under clothing: a patch of scaly skin, black nail
stages.player_hint: Something under your sleeve itches and will not heal.

stages.label: veiled
marks: dark veins spread to neck and face
stages.conceal: gloves, high collar, veil, paint; fails on close contact
gm_notes: friends begin to notice 'something is wrong'
stages.player_hint: People look at you a moment too long.

stages.label: speaking_veil
marks: bone spikes from shoulders, knuckles or spine
third eye under the brow skin (opens later)
stages.conceal: mask, full veil, cloak; only from a distance
gm_notes: the Veil speaks with your voice
stages.player_hint: You no longer recognise the face in the water.

stages.label: lost
gm_notes: hollowed: becomes an NPC under GM control

corrupted_creature.rule: A corrupted creature 'refuses to die': its HP pool is natural HP x hp_multiplier. Wound penalties, bleeding and lost limbs are measured against NATURAL HP, so it still degrades. Damage from a Crusader Knight with active Breath counts x hp_multiplier against the pool (his wounds count as if against its natural HP).
corrupted_creature.formula: pool = natural_hp * M; effective = normal_damage + breath_damage * M; dead when effective >= pool; wound_ratio = min(1, effective / natural_hp) for penalties (capped at 1 = 'should be dead')
